query: 'SELECT a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk, dp.paciente_key, dd.departamento_key, 
COALESCE(dg.diagnostico_key, nd.diagnostico_key) AS diagnostico_key, 
(YEAR(a.admission_date)*10000+MONTH(a.admission_date)*100+DAY(a.admission_date)) AS fecha_ingreso_key,
 CASE WHEN a.discharge_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (YEAR(a.discharge_date)*10000+MONTH(a.discharge_date)*100+DAY(a.discharge_date)) 
 END AS fecha_alta_key, a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id, DATEDIFF(DAY,a.admission_date,a.discharge_date) AS dias_estancia, 1 AS conteo_admisiones 
 FROM silver.admissions a JOIN gold.dim_paciente dp ON dp.patient_id_bk=a.patient_id JOIN gold.dim_departamento dd ON dd.nombre_departamento=a.department 
 OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 d.icd_code, d.severity, d.diagnosis_description FROM silver.diagnoses d WHERE d.admission_id=a.admission_id ORDER BY CASE d.severity 
 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'Severe' THEN 3 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Mild' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, d.diagnosis_id) dx 
 LEFT JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico dg ON dg.codigo_icd=dx.icd_code AND dg.nivel_severidad=ISNULL(dx.severity,'Desconocida')
  AND ISNULL(dg.descripcion_patologia,'')=ISNULL(dx.diagnosis_description,'') CROSS JOIN (SELECT diagnostico_key FROM gold.dim_diagnostico 
  WHERE codigo_icd='N/D') nd',
preSQLs:['DELETE FROM gold.fact_facturacion','DELETE FROM gold.fact_admisiones','DBCC CHECKIDENT (\'gold.fact_admisiones\', RESEED, 0)'],

query: 'SELECT b.billing_id AS billing_id_bk, b.admission_id AS admission_id_bk, fa.paciente_key, fa.departamento_key, sc.servicio_cargo_key, 
CASE WHEN b.payment_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (YEAR(b.payment_date)*10000+MONTH(b.payment_date)*100+DAY(b.payment_date)) 
END AS fecha_pago_key, b.amount AS monto_facturado, 1 AS conteo_transacciones 
FROM silver.billing b JOIN gold.fact_admisiones fa ON fa.admission_id_bk=b.admission_id JOIN gold.dim_servicio_cargo sc ON sc.tipo_cargo=b.charge_type 
AND sc.estado_pago=b.payment_status',

query: 'SELECT CAST(YEAR(f.d)*10000+MONTH(f.d)*100+DAY(f.d) AS INT) AS fecha_key, f.d AS fecha_completa, CAST(YEAR(f.d) AS SMALLINT) AS anio, 
CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER,f.d) AS SMALLINT) AS trimestre, 'T'+CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER,f.d) AS VARCHAR(1)) AS trimestre_nombre, CAST(MONTH(f.d) AS SMALLINT) AS mes, 
CHOOSE(MONTH(f.d),'Enero','Febrero','Marzo','Abril','Mayo','Junio','Julio','Agosto','Septiembre','Octubre','Noviembre','Diciembre') AS mes_nombre, 
CHOOSE(MONTH(f.d),'Ene','Feb','Mar','Abr','May','Jun','Jul','Ago','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dic') AS mes_corto, CAST(DATEPART(ISO_WEEK,f.d) AS SMALLINT) AS semana_anio,
 CAST(DAY(f.d) AS SMALLINT) AS dia_mes, CAST(w.dow AS SMALLINT) AS dia_semana, CHOOSE(w.dow,'Lunes','Martes','Miércoles','Jueves','Viernes','Sábado','Domingo') AS
  dia_nombre, CAST(CASE WHEN w.dow IN (6,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS es_fin_de_semana FROM (SELECT DATEADD(DAY, n.n, r.ini) AS d 
  FROM (SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(MIN(x)),1,1) AS ini, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(MAX(x)),12,31) AS fin FROM (SELECT admission_date AS x FROM silver.admissions 
  UNION ALL SELECT discharge_date FROM silver.admissions UNION ALL SELECT payment_date FROM silver.billing) u WHERE x IS NOT NULL) r 
  CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP (DATEDIFF(DAY,r.ini,r.fin)+1) CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))-1 AS INT) AS n FROM sys.all_objects a 
  CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b) n) f CROSS APPLY (SELECT (DATEDIFF(DAY,'19000101',f.d)%7)+1 AS dow) w',
preSQLs:['DELETE FROM gold.fact_facturacion','DELETE FROM gold.fact_admisiones','DELETE FROM gold.dim_fecha'],

query: 'SELECT p.patient_id AS patient_id_bk, p.full_name AS nombre_completo, 
CASE p.gender WHEN 'Male' THEN 'Masculino' WHEN 'Female' THEN 'Femenino' ELSE 'Otro' 
END AS genero, p.date_of_birth AS fecha_nacimiento, CASE WHEN a.edad IS NULL THEN 'Desconocido' 
WHEN a.edad<=18 THEN '0-18' WHEN a.edad<=35 THEN '19-35' WHEN a.edad<=60 THEN '36-60' ELSE '60+' END AS rango_etario, p.email AS correo_electronico, p.address 
AS direccion, ISNULL(p.insurance_provider,'Desconocido') AS proveedor_seguro FROM silver.patients p 
CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE WHEN p.date_of_birth IS NULL
 THEN NULL ELSE DATEDIFF(YEAR,p.date_of_birth,GETDATE()) - 
 CASE WHEN DATEADD(YEAR,DATEDIFF(YEAR,p.date_of_birth,GETDATE()),p.date_of_birth)>CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS edad) a',
preSQLs:['DELETE FROM gold.fact_facturacion','DELETE FROM gold.fact_admisiones','DELETE FROM gold.dim_paciente','DBCC CHECKIDENT (\'gold.dim_paciente\', RESEED, 0)'],
query: 'SELECT DISTINCT charge_type AS tipo_cargo, payment_status AS estado_pago FROM silver.billing',

query: 'SELECT b.diagnosis_id, b.admission_id, b.diagnosis_description, b.severity, LTRIM(RTRIM(s.value)) AS icd_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.diagnosis_id ORDER BY s.value) AS n FROM bronze.diagnoses b CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(b.icd_code, CHAR(44)) s WHERE LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.value))) > 0',
